subject: planner: skip out of range for full range (#65854)
summary: Adds an `atFullRange` guard (using `cost.ToleranceFactor`) to skip histogram out-of-range row-count adjustments in both column and index range row-count estimation when the scaled estimate already covers ~all `realtimeRowCount`, avoiding redundant/double-counting on full-range predicates; updates Bazel deps accordingly.
